address: 56 High Street, Dumfries, DG1 2JA, United Kingdom
bio: This historic pub – whose name references its origins – is well known as a favourite haunt of legendary Scottish poet, Robert Burns, and with over 300 whiskies available in the snug in which he held court, a drink here is a must. The vintage-style restaurant, with its Tam o’Shanter mural, is an atmospheric place to dine. The menu puts Scottish produce to the fore, and dishes are creative, modern, and full of colour and flavour....
